profile.headline: New Media Artist, Digital Strategist, Creative Technologist
profile.summary:
8+ years experience working with machine learning models, prompt engineering, generative AI, LLMs, Claude (Code, Design, CoWork), Colab notebooks (Stable Diffusion, GPT-X, etc), Replicate (FLUX), AI IDEs (Cursor), and AI chatbots.
16+ years experience in modern front-end web development, user-centered design methodologies, visual communication, inbound marketing, paid marketing, SEO, project management.
25+ years experience in time-based media, critical and conceptual thinking, and visual arts.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
• Building custom sites and with JAMstack, React, Jekyll, node.js, etc. 
• Building experimental websites with bleeding-edge tech for exhibitions and archives. 
• Developing content and visual communication strategies. 
• Coding, designing, testing, and optimizing B2B and B2C landing pages. 
• Doing keyword research, competitor analysis, and backlink analysis. 
• Optimizing websites for performance, accessibility, SEO, and user intent.


Projects and Highlights:
• 2022 Co-led Javascript development with UCLA Arts Conditional Studio for MIRRORARCHIVE.NET an artist-focused public archive documenting the first decades of artists who create work with software and for the internet. In collaboration with Color Coded.
• 2021 Co-led the Javascript development, UX and design for the interactive archive, ARCHIVE.SHEWHOSEESTHEUNKNOWN.COM an assembly of books, manuscripts, and images of female and non-binary/queer figures in West Asian ancient stories that are often misrepresented or forgotten; by Morehshin Allahyari.
• 2020 Led Javascript development for the interactive archive, BLACKTRANSARCHIVE.COM by Danielle Brathwaite-Shirley for London Science Gallery.
• 2019 Web development, UX/UI design, and information architecture for RUHABENJAMIN.COM, the official website for the sociologist, professor and author, Ruha Benjamin. In collaboration with Color Coded.
• 2018 Led Javascript development, 3D scene design, and UX design for the hypertext narrative, “The Laughing Snake” by artist Morehshin Allahyari for the Whitney Museum of American Art. 
• 2019 Played a key role as a strategic partner on the design, development, marketing, and positioning strategy for Aeon Laser USA, contributing to growth from zero to $10M+ in 3 years.
• 2017 Led the visual communication strategy and web development for a campaign site to #BuyTwitter, achieving campaign goals and earned international press coverage in 100+ articles.

More at: https://emilyknowshtml.netlify.app/

positions.title: Artist
positions.description:
Making art about new economies created by cryptocurrencies and the so-called “sharing economy”. Examining how these economic concepts intersect with neoliberalism, colonialism, class warfare, race, altruism, utopianism, creativity, and exploitation. Developing a series of videos, downloads, online generators, surveys, quizzes, workshops, books, and net art projects.

Notable achievements:
• Co-authored a book exploring the artist as entrepreneur, labor, automation, and the gig economy titled, "The Future of Work".
• Outsourced a keynote presentation for a tech conference to a gig worker from the sharing economy. It was a hit.
• Published in Art in America, Media-N, Temporary Art Review, and The Entreprecariat: Pervasive Labour Union zine.
• Exhibited in over 40+ venues internationally, including Drugo More (Rijeka, Croatia), Transmediale (Berlin, DE), Yerba Buena Center for the Arts (San Francisco), MoMA PS1 (New York), V2_Lab for the Unstable Media (Rotterdam, NL), The Luminary (St. Louis), The Institute of Network Cultures (Amsterdam, NL), and The Wrong Biennale.

More at https://anxioustomake.com

positions.title: Assistant Crew Leader, Enumerator
positions.description:
ASSISTANT CREW LEADER, MIAMI EAST ELCO, FL, 2010
	•	Supervised 10+ enumerators during field operations.
	•	Performed preparatory duties such as checking boundaries and becoming familiar with the areas where employees would work.
	•	Assigned duty areas to employees, observed employees in the field, and provided on-the-spot assistance and supervision.
	•	Reviewed and certified daily payroll and progress reports and ensured that work was completed within established time schedules.

ENUMERATOR, ADDRESS CANVASSING OPERATION, MIAMI EAST ELCO, FL, 2009
	•	Used specialized hand-held computers with GPS technology to geolocate addresses and identify living quarters in order to update a complete and accurate address list and spatial database for enumeration. 
	•	Determined the type and address characteristics for each living quarter.
	•	Worked in challenging areas that were difficult to access or that needed to be mapped from scratch, including small islands, new developments under construction, and underdeveloped rural areas. 

ENUMERATOR, GROUP QUARTERS VERIFICATION OPERATION, MIAMI EAST ELCO, FL, 2009
	•	Conducted interviews with residents in assigned areas by following stringent guidelines and confidentiality laws. Explained the purpose of the census interview, answered residents' questions, elicited information following a script, and recorded census data on forms.
	•	Assessed quality control levels on selected addresses, determined which samples passed or failed, and maintained records for quality control verification.
	•	Complied with accuracy standards while maintaining high production rates.
